verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows GitHub itself letting developers view or manage external issue-tracker tickets inside the code host, or open them from pull requests. The only related item is a third-party Marketplace app (GitHub for Atlassian) that syncs development data with Jira. That app is an adjacent ecosystem integration, not GitHub's own capability, and it does not document in-GitHub ticket views or PR-to-ticket linking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage tickets from an external issue tracker inside the code host and open them from pull requests
